meta.title: Youhan Huang
meta.description: Undergraduate at BUPT. Computer vision, intelligent sensing, and machine learning.

profile.name: Youhan Huang
profile.affiliation: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
profile.bio: I am an undergraduate at BUPT working on computer vision and intelligent sensing. I care about clean problem formulations, reproducible experiments, and systems that connect perception algorithms to real sensing hardware.

education.school: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
details: Selected coursework: Engineering Mathematics (97), Linear Algebra (94), Computer Networks (97), Programming Fundamentals (96), Introduction to AI (95), Machine Learning (95)

news.text: Co-first author (ranked first) paper accepted as Oral at ICME 2026 (CCF-B).
Joined the Image Aesthetics Assessment group at BUPT; working on long-form video aesthetics assessment.
Led construction of a multi-task mouse NAFLD pathology scoring dataset.
Joined the Pattern Recognition & Intelligent Vision Lab at BUPT for polarization-guided transparent object reconstruction.
Started research internship at Peking University.

publications.title: Parameter-Efficient Subspace Decoupling ViT for Mitigating Multi-Task Negative Transfer in Histological Scoring
publications.authors: Youhan Huang*, Jiajun Li*, Yilin Fang*, Shuai Wang, Chuheng Li

research.role: Project Lead · Mouse NAFLD Multi-Task Pathology Scoring
research.summary: Built a curated multi-task NAFLD histology dataset and a subspace-decoupled multi-task ViT with task-specific Adapters and orthogonality constraints to reduce negative transfer among NAS indicators. Co-first author (ranked first); ICME 2026 Oral.

Worked on device-free multi-radar extrinsic calibration that models walking humans as elliptical cylinders for relative pose recovery. Also built end-to-end pipelines for real-time human pose estimation on low-cost 24 GHz mmWave radars under tight bandwidth constraints.

research.org: BUPT · Pattern Recognition & Intelligent Vision Lab
research.summary: Studied polarization-guided neural implicit surface reconstruction for transparent objects, combining polarized illumination modeling with dual-surface light transport and an implicit geometric representation.
Supported research that reframes video aesthetics assessment from holistic scoring toward fine-grained spatiotemporal quantification, including baselines, evaluations, and writing.

intern.summary: Building automatic experiment agents, cleaning industrial datasets, and developing time-series world models for forecasting in industrial scenarios.
